newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CNP/NPM H1 net rises, sees further gains.
newsitem.headline: CNP/NPM H1 net rises, sees further gains.

text.p: Six months to June 30, 1996 (in billions of Belgian francs unless stated)

NOTE - Cie. Nationale a Portefeuille/Nationale Portefeuillemaatschappij is an investment vehicle of Belgian financier Albert Frere, which in turn controls Swiss based Pargesa Holding and Belgium's Groupe Bruxelles Lambert.

In a statement, CNP/NPM said its second half results should be boosted by extraordinary gains from the sale of its stake in SCI & Associes and its share of the 41 billion Belgian francs sale by its Electrafina unit of shares in Belgian utility Tractebel.
The second half could also include some write backs on earlier provisions, the company said.
"Without any major event...the dividend payable on 1996 earnings will be higher (than 1995)," the company said.
